title: CT Scans — What They Show, When They Are Used and What the Report Means

hook.en: A CT scan gives a detailed 3D picture in minutes and is common after trauma and for chest and head problems. Learn what it shows well, how it differs from MRI and how to read a report with care.
hook.ur: CT scan chand minute mein tafseeli 3D tasveer deta hai aur trauma, seene aur sar ke masail mein aam hai. Seekhein yeh kya achha dikhata hai, MRI se kaise mukhtalif hai aur report ko ehtiyat se kaise parhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain how CT works, say what it shows best, compare it with X-ray and MRI, understand windows, contrast and radiation, and read key report terms safely.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke CT kaise kaam karta hai, kya sab se achha dikhata hai, isay X-ray aur MRI se muqabil karenge, windows, contrast aur radiation samjhenge, aur report ke aham alfaz mehfooz tareeqe se parhenge.

text.en: A **CT (computed tomography) scan** takes many X-ray pictures around the body and a computer builds **slices** (cross-sections) and 3D images. It shows **bone detail, bleeding, the lungs and many organs** very well, and it is **fast**, which is why it is used in **trauma and emergencies**. Compared with MRI it shows soft tissues such as discs, ligaments and nerves less well, and it uses **more radiation than a plain X-ray**.
text.ur: **CT (computed tomography) scan** jism ke gird bohat si X-ray tasveerein leta hai aur computer **slices** (cross-sections) aur 3D tasveerein banata hai. Yeh **haddi ki tafseel, khoon behna, phephre aur bohat se aza** bohat achhe dikhata hai, aur **tez** hai, is liye **trauma aur emergencies** mein istemal hota hai. MRI ke muqable mein yeh disc, ligaments aur nerves jaise narm tissues kam achhe dikhata hai, aur **saade X-ray se zyada radiation** istemal karta hai.

text.en: Think of CT as **slicing a loaf of bread**. Instead of one flat shadow you see each slice, so you can see where a crumb or a hole sits inside. Bread with a hard crust (bone) shows beautifully; soft detail in the middle needs a different tool (MRI).
text.ur: CT ko **double roti ko katna** samjhein. Ek chapti parchhai ke bajaye aap har slice dekhte hain, is liye pata chalta hai ke andar crumb ya sooraakh kahan hai. Sakht chhilke wali roti (haddi) khoobsurat nazar aati hai; beech ki narm tafseel ke liye doosra auzaar (MRI) chahiye.

steps.title: Know the reason for the scan
steps.detail: Check why it was done (trauma, suspected bleed, fracture detail, lungs, abdomen) and whether contrast was used. The question decides what the radiologist looks for. || Scan ki wajah jaanein

steps.title: Understand the windows
steps.detail: The same scan is shown in different "windows" so that bone, lung or brain can each be seen best. Bone is bright in a bone window, air is black in a lung window. A report refers to the window that fits the question. || Windows samjhein

steps.title: Read the findings and the impression
steps.detail: The "findings" describe what was seen in each area. The "impression" at the end gives the main conclusion. Read both, and note words such as "acute", "displaced", "comminuted" or "no acute abnormality". || Findings aur impression parhein

steps.title: Link it to the patient
steps.detail: Compare the result with the history and examination. Ask whether the result changes the plan, such as protection, weight-bearing limits or referral. Query anything that does not fit. || Mareez se jorein

text.en: **CT for bone and speed, MRI for soft tissue.** Choose the scan for the question. Remember that every extra scan has a cost: radiation for CT, time and confinement for MRI.
text.ur: **CT haddi aur raftar ke liye, MRI narm tissue ke liye.** Scan sawal ke mutabiq chunein. Yaad rakhein ke har ziyada scan ki qeemat hai: CT mein radiation, MRI mein waqt aur tang jagah.

text.en: **Assuming a normal CT means there is no injury.** A CT can miss ligament tears, early stress fractures and nerve problems. If the patient's story and examination point to a problem, a normal scan does not close the case: discuss next steps with the doctor.
text.ur: **Normal CT ka matlab chot nahi samajhna.** CT ligament tears, shuruati stress fractures aur nerve masail miss kar sakta hai. Mareez ki kahani aur examination masle ki taraf ishara karein to normal scan kes band nahi karta: agle qadam doctor ke saath discuss karein.

question.ur: Mareez ka contrast ke saath CT hua aur use gurde ki bimari hai. Aap kya check karein?

text.ur: Kuch nahi; contrast hamesha begarar hai

feedback.ur: Contrast kuch mareezon ke liye khatra rakhta hai.

text.en: That the medical team is aware and the kidney function and fluids are being monitored
text.ur: Ke medical team ko maloom hai aur gurde ka function aur fluids monitor ho rahe hain

feedback.en: Yes — contrast can strain the kidneys.
feedback.ur: Haan — contrast gurdon par dabao daal sakta hai.

text.ur: Foran zyada shiddat ki exercise shuru karein

feedback.en: Exercise should wait for medical clearance if there is a concern.

question.en: What does the "impression" in a CT report give?
question.ur: CT report mein "impression" kya deti hai?

feedback.en: The report does not decide your plan.
feedback.ur: Report aap ka plan tay nahi karti.

text.en: A list of every possible disease

feedback.en: It gives the main conclusion, not a list of everything.
feedback.ur: Yeh mukhya nateeja deti hai, sab ki fehrist nahi.

feedback.en: Yes — read the findings as well as the impression.
feedback.ur: Haan — findings ke saath impression bhi parhein.

text.en: **Explain scans in plain words.** For example: "A CT takes many X-ray pictures to build slices of the body. It shows bones and bleeding very clearly. It is quick, and the radiation dose is small, but we only do it when the answer will change your care." Reassure a worried patient and invite questions.
text.ur: **Scans saade alfaz mein samjhayein.** Maslan: "CT bohat si X-ray tasveerein le kar jism ke slices banata hai. Yeh haddiyan aur khoon behna saaf dikhata hai. Yeh tez hai aur radiation ki dose chhoti hai, magar hum sirf tab karte hain jab jawab aap ki care badalta ho." Pareshan mareez ko tasalli dein aur sawal ki dawat dein.

question.en: Why is CT used first in many emergency head and trauma cases?
question.ur: Bohat si emergency sar aur trauma ki surat mein CT pehle kyun istemal hota hai?

answer.en: It is fast and shows bleeding and fractures clearly, and can be done in a patient who is unwell or cannot lie still for long. A quick answer about life-threatening bleeding outweighs the small radiation dose.
answer.ur: Yeh tez hai aur khoon behna aur fractures saaf dikhata hai, aur beemar ya der saakit na reh sakne wale mareez mein bhi ho sakta hai. Jaan lewa khoon behne ka tez jawab radiation ki chhoti dose se zyada ahem hai.

beats.patient: A 70-year-old woman falls and has severe pain in her hip, and the X-ray is reported as normal. She cannot bear weight. The doctor orders a CT, which shows a fracture of the femoral neck.
beats.assessment: A normal X-ray did not exclude a hip fracture; the CT shows what the plain film missed.
beats.treatment: Keep her still and comfortable, avoid weight-bearing, and make sure the orthopaedic team has the result urgently.
beats.reassess: She has surgery within a day and starts rehabilitation after the operation.

text.en: **Follow your clinic's rules about radiation and pregnancy:** tell the doctor if a patient may be pregnant, and avoid unnecessary repeat scans. Do not start rehabilitation on a limb with a newly found fracture, bleed or unstable injury until the medical team has cleared it. Report new red flags (worsening headache, drowsiness, numbness, chest pain, breathlessness) at once.
text.ur: **Radiation aur hamal ke baare mein clinic ke qawaid maanein:** mareez ke hamila hone ka imkaan ho to doctor ko batayein, aur ghair zaroori dohraye scans se bachein. Nayi mili fracture, khoon behne ya ghair mustaqil chot wale ang par medical team ki ijazat se pehle rehabilitation shuru na karein. Nayi red flags (barhta sar dard, neend, sunn hona, seene ka dard, saans ki tangi) foran report karein.

summary.en: CT builds slices from many X-ray pictures; it is fast and shows bone, bleeding and lungs well, but shows soft tissue less well than MRI and uses radiation.
summary.ur: CT bohat si X-ray tasveeron se slices banata hai; yeh tez hai aur haddi, khoon behna aur phephre achhe dikhata hai, magar narm tissue MRI se kam dikhata hai aur radiation istemal karta hai.

summary.en: Read both the findings and the impression, note whether contrast was used and link the result to the patient.
summary.ur: Findings aur impression dono parhein, note karein kya contrast istemal hua aur nateeje ko mareez se jorein.

summary.en: A normal CT does not rule out ligament, stress-fracture or nerve problems; follow the story and the examination.
summary.ur: Normal CT ligament, stress fracture ya nerve ke masail rule out nahi karta; kahani aur examination par chalein.
